name: tables
description: Headless Airtable-like data tables SDK — bases, typed fields (text/number/select/date/checkbox/link/formula/lookup), records, views (filter/sort/group), formula + lookup engine, and CSV/JSON import-export. Primary surfaces: the headless SDK ('.') and a Glide-Data-Grid React component ('./react'). Ships a `tables` CLI backed by local JSON base files under ~/.hasna/tables. An HTTP API (tables-serve), MCP server (tables-mcp), and Postgres store are PLANNED, not yet implemented in v0.1.
